an1.333:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave appamattakaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakaṃ.
an1.333:1.2: atha kho etadeva bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ ukkūlavikūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakādhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ.
an1.333:1.3: evamevaṃ kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye thalajā. atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye odakā.
an1.334:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye manussesu paccājāyanti.
an1.334:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye aññatra manussehi paccājāyanti.
an1.335:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāyanti.
an1.335:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye paccantimesu janapadesu paccājāyanti aviññātāresu milakkhesu.
an1.336:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye paññavanto ajaḷā aneḷamūgā paṭibalā subhāsitadubbhāsitassa atthamaññātuṃ.
an1.336:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye duppaññā jaḷā eḷamūgā na paṭibalā subhāsitadubbhāsitassa atthamaññātuṃ.
an1.337:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye ariyena paññācakkhunā samannāgatā.
an1.337:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye avijjāgatā sammūḷhā.
an1.338:1.1: -pe- evamevaṃ kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye labhanti tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
an1.338:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye na labhanti tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
an1.339:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye labhanti tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savaṇāya.
an1.339:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā, ye na labhanti tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savanāya.
an1.340:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye sutvā dhammaṃ dhārenti.
an1.340:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā, ye sutvā dhammaṃ na dhārenti.
an1.341:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhanti.
an1.341:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ na upaparikkhanti.
an1.342:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjanti.
an1.342:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammaṃ na paṭipajjanti.
an1.343:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye saṃvejanīyesu ṭhānesu saṃvijjanti.
an1.343:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye saṃvejanīyesu ṭhānesu na saṃvijjanti.
an1.344:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye saṃviggā yoniso padahanti.
an1.344:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye saṃviggā yoniso na padahanti.
an1.345:1.1: evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye vavassaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhanti samādhiṃ, labhanti cittassa ekaggaṃ.
an1.345:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye vavassaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā na labhanti samādhiṃ, na labhanti cittassa ekaggaṃ.
an1.346:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye annaggarasaggānaṃ lābhino.
an1.346:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye annaggarasaggānaṃ na lābhino uñchena kapālābhatena yāpenti.
an1.347:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa lābhino.
an1.347:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa na lābhino.
an1.348-350:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave appamattakaṃ imasmiṃ jambudīpe ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakaṃ,
an1.348-350:1.2: atha kho etadeva bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ ukkūlavikūlaṃ nadīviduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakādhānaṃ pabbatavisamaṃ.
an1.348-350:1.3: evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye manussā cutā manussesu paccājāyanti. atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā, ye manussā cutā niraye paccājāyanti, -pe- tiracchānayoniyā paccājāyanti, -pe- pettivisaye paccājāyanti.
an1.351-353:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye manussā cutā devesu paccājāyanti.
an1.351-353:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā, ye manussā cutā niraye paccājāyanti. -pe- tiracchānayoniyā paccājāyanti. -pe- pettivisaye paccājāyanti.
an1.354-356:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye devā cutā devesu paccājāyanti.
an1.354-356:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā, ye devā cutā niraye paccājāyanti. -pe- atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā, ye tiracchānayoniyā paccājāyanti. -pe- pettivisaye paccājāyanti.

an1.357-359:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye devā cutā niraye paccājāyanti. -pe- tiracchānayoniyā paccājāyanti. -pe- pettivisaye paccājāyanti.

an1.360-362:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye nirayā cutā niraye paccājāyanti. -pe- tiracchānayoniyā paccājāyanti. -pe- pettivisaye paccājāyanti.

an1.363-365:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye nirayā cutā niraye paccājāyanti. -pe- tiracchānayoniyā paccājāyanti. -pe- pettivisaye paccājāyanti.

an1.366-368:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye tiracchānayoniyā cutā niraye paccājāyanti. -pe- tiracchānayoniyā paccājāyanti. -pe- pettivisaye paccājāyanti.
an1.369-371:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye tiracchānayoniyā cutā devesu paccājāyanti.
an1.369-371:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye tiracchānayoniyā cutā niraye paccājāyanti. -pe- tiracchānayoniyā paccājāyanti. -pe- pettivisaye paccājāyanti.
an1.372-374:1.1: -pe- evameva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye pettivisayā cutā manussesu paccājāyanti.
an1.372-374:1.2: atha kho eteva sattā bahutarā ye pettivisayā cutā niraye paccājāyanti. -pe- tiracchānayoniyā paccājāyanti. -pe- pettivisaye paccājāyanti.
